The main takeaway from our work is that
China's growing energy use and CO2 emissions are driven by consumption and that the most effective policies for reducing emissions are those that target changes in consumption patterns.

China's emissions growth has largely been driven by changes in consumption, not production, suggesting that the focus of future emissions mitigation efforts should be to improve the efficiency of consumption, not just production.
